steady_state_idempotency.scope: current implementation attempt plus clean candidate ref/SHA and instrument; existing samples satisfy or top up the requested target unless --append is used
positive_features: non-baseline observation requires a named candidate ref
worktree must be clean and HEAD must match the candidate ref
prior observations are filtered by attempt and candidate ref/SHA
stored samples are reused instead of blindly re-running once durable

pre_execution_logical_query_prepare.evidence: runAndRecordObservationWithDecorator calls instrument.Run before allocating an observation ID or writing observation state

crash_window.window: instrument/evaluator finishes after consuming the evaluation surface, but process dies before artifact/observation persistence
crash_window.consequence: next observe invocation sees insufficient durable samples and may run the same logical candidate/instrument evaluation again

logical_exactly_once_consumption.reason: idempotency is derived from already-recorded observation/sample sufficiency rather than a stable pre-dispatch logical query record

hard_kill_fault_matrix.scope: no claim of absence beyond inspected/searchable public revision

design_distinction.steady_state_idempotency: do not repeat work once a durable result exists
design_distinction.crash_atomicity: if external/evaluation work completed but its local record did not, recovery must reconcile rather than consume the evaluation again

composition_with_sequence_79: AegisEvo provides a stable logical job ID/fencing above retries; hugoferreira/autoresearch provides strong candidate-snapshot-scoped sample reuse but exposes the same pre-record crash window because evaluator execution precedes logical result persistence. These are complementary evidence that stable identity must be created and charged before evaluation dispatch, not inferred after success.
next_falsifier: Take an idempotent-by-default observe implementation and inject process death immediately after instrument completion but before WriteObservation. Verify whether restart consumes a second physical evaluation. Then add a stable pre-run logical observation/query ID plus provider receipt reconciliation and require identical logical/physical consumption under uninterrupted versus kill-resume execution.
